sources.summary: Nvidia is investigating a security incident involving its Brev cloud development platform after detecting unauthorized activity between October 4 and October 20. stories.title: 索尼最后一款4K蓝光播放器在日本上市缺货，公司或准备放弃独立播放器 / Sony's final 4K Blu-ray player listed as out of stock in Japan, firm may be preparing to abandon standalone players

sources.title: 索尼最后一款4K蓝光播放器在日本上市缺货，公司或准备放弃独立播放器 / Sony's final 4K Blu-ray player listed as out of stock in Japan, firm may be preparing to abandon standalone players
sources.title_zh: 索尼最后一款4K蓝光播放器在日本上市缺货，公司或准备放弃独立播放器
sources.title_en: Sony's final 4K Blu-ray player listed as out of stock in Japan, firm may be preparing to abandon standalone players
sources.title_original: Sony's final 4K Blu-ray player listed as out of stock in Japan, firm may be preparing to abandon standalone players
sources.summary: Sony may be preparing to abandon the standalone 4K Blu-ray player market after retailers in Japan reportedly stopped expecting new shipments of its final remaining model, the UBP-X700K. The company has not confirmed a worldwide withdrawal, and the player remains listed in the U.S. However, Sony's retreat from other physical media products, alongside exits by Oppo, Samsung, LG, and Reavon, raises further questions about the future of dedicated disc players.
sources.summary_zh: 据报道，日本零售商不再期待其最后一款型号 UBP-X700K 的新出货量，索尼可能正准备放弃独立 4K 蓝光播放器市场。该公司尚未确认在全球范围内退出，该播放器仍在美国上市。然而，索尼退出其他物理媒体产品，加上 Oppo、三星、LG 和 Reavon 的退出，引发了人们对专用光盘播放器未来的进一步质疑。

sources.summary: GOG wants to sell physical games, in contrast to consoles going digital-only, giving gamers more freedom over their games. However, it still has to figure out logistics and publisher permissions.
